protocol:
Conjugation of Thalassiosira pseudonana
Pick bacterial colonies from your Gent+Kan plates and inoculate 10 mL LB medium.
Grow overnight.
Measure OD600 and start a 150 mL LB subculture (recommended starting OD600 either 0.05 or 0.1).
Grow at 37oC until OD600 reaches 0.3-0.4.
Centrifuge at 4,000 rpm, 10oC, for 10 min.
Decant supernatant and resuspend in 800 µL SOC.
Tp was cultured in L1 medium as described in the 'Before start' section.
Spin down 2 x 108 cells at 4000 rpm, 10oC, for 10 min.
Decant supernatant and resuspend pellet in 1 mL L1 medium.
Mix 200 µL T. pseudonana cells and 200 µL E. coli cells in a 1.5 mL tube.
Pipette up and down a few times.
Plate on 1/2xL1 1% agar plates w/ 5% LB.
Incubate in dark at 30oC for 90 minutes.
Move plates to your standard Tp growth conditions - in my case 18oC and constant light - for 4 hours.
Add 1 mL L1 medium and scrape with a cell scraper or L spreader.
Expect to recover ~500 µL co-culture suspension after scraping.
Plate 200 µL of the resulting suspension on pre-dried 1/2xL1 1% agar plates w/ 100 µg/mL nourseothricin.
Leave at 18oC and constant light until colonies appear - ~2 weeks.
Here are a few ways to confirm the presence and expression of your heterologous gene in resulting colonies:
Growth under selection pressure.
Make sure colonies are able to grow in liquid L1 medium with 100 µg/mL nourseothricin (Nou100).
Pick colonies with a small tip or better a toothpick and inoculate ~0.5 mL L1 medium.
Once you observe growth subculture in larger volume.
PCR- Use 1 µL of diatom culture as a template to amplify your expression cassette.
- Confirm the absence of donor DNA by amplifying E. coli-specific genes.
NOTE:I used primers to amplify the corC gene.
Make sure you always run E. coli EPI300 posititve control.
- Confirm the absence of live donor cells by plating some diatom culture on LB plates w/o antibiotics.
NOTE: Any remaining donors cells and donor DNA are gone after a few liquid subcultures.
You can also patch colonies on fresh 1/2xL1 Nou100 plates.
RT-PCR- Purify total RNA from Nou100 diatom culture, convert it to cDNA and use it to run a PCR with heterologous gene-specific primers.
- An example of my result with controls can be found here.
Episome recovery- Perform a diatom miniprep as described by Karas et al.
(2015).
- Transform E. coli with diatom-derived DNA.
- Select on LB agar plates with 50 µg/mL kanamycin.
- Miniprep, digest and analyze on a gel.
NOTE:You will learn more about the state of your episome from this analysis.
Western blot
Protein-specific assays- enzymatic assay, microscopy etc.
I've had success with 1, 2 and 3; tried 4, 5 and 6 without success.

parameters.reagent: 200 µL T. pseudonana cells and 200 µL E. coli cells

parameters.volume: variable (up and down a few times)

parameters.container: pre-dried 1/2xL1 1% agar plates w/ 100 µg/mL nourseothricin

parameters.reagent: total RNA from Nou100 diatom culture

parameters.container: LB agar plates with 50 µg/mL kanamycin

# Lab Automation Script
# Generated from protocol analysis


### MANUAL SECTION ###
# MANUAL: inoculate (container: 10 mL LB medium, reagent: bacterial colonies from Gent+Kan plates, volume: 10 mL, other: {})

### AUTOMATED SECTION ###
incubate(container='LB medium', reagent='bacterial culture', volume='10 mL', duration='overnight')

### MANUAL SECTION ###
# MANUAL: measure (container: bacterial culture, other: {'measurement': 'OD600'})
# MANUAL: start (container: 150 mL LB subculture, reagent: bacterial culture, volume: 150 mL, other: {'starting_OD600': '0.05 or 0.1'})

### AUTOMATED SECTION ###
incubate(container='LB subculture', reagent='bacterial culture', volume='150 mL', temperature='37°C', duration='until OD600 reaches 0.3-0.4')
centrifuge(container='bacterial culture', temperature='10°C', duration='10 min', speed='4000 rpm')

### MANUAL SECTION ###
# MANUAL: decant (container: centrifuged tube, reagent: supernatant, other: {})

### AUTOMATED SECTION ###
resuspend(container='centrifuged tube', reagent='SOC', volume='800 µL')
spin(container='Tp culture', reagent='2 x 10^8 cells', temperature='10°C', duration='10 min', speed='4000 rpm')

### MANUAL SECTION ###
# MANUAL: decant (container: centrifuged tube, reagent: supernatant, other: {})

### AUTOMATED SECTION ###
resuspend(container='centrifuged tube', reagent='L1 medium', volume='1 mL')
mix(container='1.5 mL tube', reagent='200 µL T. pseudonana cells and 200 µL E. coli cells', volume='400 µL total')
pipette(container='1.5 mL tube', reagent='cell mixture', volume='variable (up and down a few times)', repeat='a few times')

### MANUAL SECTION ###
# MANUAL: plate (container: 1/2xL1 1% agar plates w/ 5% LB, reagent: cell mixture, other: {})

### AUTOMATED SECTION ###
incubate(container='agar plates', reagent='plated cells', temperature='30°C', duration='90 min', light='dark')

### MANUAL SECTION ###
# MANUAL: move (container: plates, temperature: 18°C, duration: 4 hours, other: {'light': 'constant light'})

### AUTOMATED SECTION ###
add(container='plates', reagent='L1 medium', volume='1 mL')

### MANUAL SECTION ###
# MANUAL: scrape (container: plates, reagent: cells, other: {'tool': 'cell scraper or L spreader'})
# MANUAL: plate (container: pre-dried 1/2xL1 1% agar plates w/ 100 µg/mL nourseothricin, reagent: co-culture suspension, volume: 200 µL, other: {})

### AUTOMATED SECTION ###
incubate(container='agar plates', reagent='plated suspension', temperature='18°C', duration='~2 weeks (until colonies appear)', light='constant light')

### MANUAL SECTION ###
# MANUAL: inoculate (container: ~0.5 mL L1 medium, reagent: colonies, volume: 0.5 mL, other: {'tool': 'small tip or toothpick'})
# MANUAL: subculture (container: larger volume, reagent: grown colonies, other: {})

### AUTOMATED SECTION ###
PCR(reagent='1 µL diatom culture', volume='1 µL', template='expression cassette')
amplify(reagent='E. coli-specific genes')
run(reagent='E. coli EPI300 positive control')

### MANUAL SECTION ###
# MANUAL: plate (container: LB plates w/o antibiotics, reagent: diatom culture, other: {})
# MANUAL: patch (container: fresh 1/2xL1 Nou100 plates, reagent: colonies, other: {})

### AUTOMATED SECTION ###
purify(reagent='total RNA from Nou100 diatom culture')
convert(reagent='RNA to cDNA')
run(reagent='PCR with heterologous gene-specific primers')
miniprep(reagent='diatom culture')
transform(reagent='E. coli with diatom-derived DNA')

### MANUAL SECTION ###
# MANUAL: select (container: LB agar plates with 50 µg/mL kanamycin, reagent: transformed E. coli, other: {})

### AUTOMATED SECTION ###
miniprep(reagent='selected E. coli')
digest(reagent='miniprep DNA')
analyze(container='gel', reagent='digested DNA')
western blot()
assay(reagent='protein-specific', type='enzymatic assay, microscopy etc.')
